hook.name: ForgeHook
hook.description: Applies a flat 1% sell tax and a cliff-style launch buy tax (90% flat for 5 minutes post-launch, then 0%) on every swap in the FORGE/pair pool, skimming collected fees to a treasury address. Exact-input swaps are taxed in beforeSwap via delta returns; exact-output swaps are taxed in afterSwap. Also overrides LP fee to a flat 0.30% on every swap.
